name: claude-toolbox
description: Official Claude Code toolbox from Kanopi Studios for Content Management System (CMS) development

plugins.name: cms-cultivator
plugins.description: Agent Skills and specialist agents for Drupal and WordPress development. PR workflows, design-to-code (Figma → blocks/paragraphs) with responsive styling and real-browser validation, test scaffolding and coverage analysis, documentation generation, Drupal.org contribution workflows, Composer patch generation, and git worktree management.

plugins.name: delivery-record
plugins.description: Schema-typed, human-signed Delivery Records for AI-assisted work. Generate a record for any significant output with a mandatory named-reviewer checkpoint, then verify records against the bundled JSON Schema spec with the threshold rule (fail needs a waiver, n/a needs a justification). MIT licensed.

plugins.name: claude-dev-insights
plugins.description: Comprehensive developer analytics and productivity insights for Claude Code. Automatically tracks session analytics, enforces security policies, guards against cost overruns, and ensures code quality with 4 intelligent hooks: SessionEnd, SessionStart, PreToolUse, and PostToolUse.

plugins.name: cc-teamwork-token-count
plugins.description: SessionStart hook that logs every Claude Code session to a JSONL file with git branch and parsed Teamwork task ID. Adds a /tw-token-count slash command that aggregates ccusage token spend per Teamwork task, with optional Teamwork MCP enrichment for task and project names.

plugins.name: screencast-skills
plugins.description: Author and produce narrated, captioned screencast tutorials for any tool on macOS. screencast-storyboard reads the tool's real docs and drafts an approved storyboard (never fabricating config); screencast-tutorial-video records each scene with the right engine: VHS for terminals, ffmpeg still-motion for native apps, headless Playwright for the browser, command cards for abstract commands. It adds ElevenLabs or OpenAI voice-over and assembles a 1920x1080 MP4. Brand presets set the house voice, pronunciation, and look.
